set.body:
Objective:
Provide an optional frame-gale integration that crosses explicitly from heterogeneous relational data into Gale numerical views without making either library own the other.

Scope:
- Single required contiguous Float64 chunks may expose borrowed DVec-compatible views only when Gale public storage and lifetime contracts can represent the underlying platform buffer safely.
- Nullable and chunked columns require an explicit require-no-nulls, fill, drop, masked, rechunk, or materialize policy.
- Ordinary independently allocated columns do not claim zero-copy DMat conversion. materializeDMat reports packing and layout costs; asColumnOperator may provide a non-packing numerical view.
- DMat-to-Frame or specialized matrix-backed physical intermediates may be zero-copy only behind explicit ownership and encoding proofs.
- Row keys, selected column identities, null decisions, and packing receipts accompany matrix datasets.
- Frame core and the local engine remain Gale-free; general formulas, regression, PCA, and statistical models remain above this adapter.

Acceptance:
- Every conversion returns a structured Borrowed, Shared, Rechunked, Filled, Compacted, Packed, or Copied receipt.
- Vector and operator results agree with Frame scalar access and independent packed oracles across slices, offsets, chunks, null policies, and owner closure.
- No view outlives its owner; unsupported Gale storage layouts fail before exposing a value.
- JVM and Scala.js cover their supported zero-copy and materialized routes.
- Frame and Gale can be versioned, tested, and published independently.
set.title: Frame adapter: Gale numerical views with explicit lifetime and allocation receipts
